item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has resumed missile strikes on Russian oil refineries and a missile-maintenance base, using Storm Shadow missiles supplied by the United Kingdom, while Russian drones have attacked ships in the Black Sea near Romania, leaving seven crew members missing. Kyiv blames SpaceX for throttling Starlink terminals that support its drone operations, and Russia has detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
